title: Welcome to Updates & Notices
body:
This is where we'll share announcements, new features, and important notices about FreeTV Garden — so you always know what's changed.

**Stay connected with us:**

- 📢 Join our [Telegram channel](https://t.me/Freetools_channel) for the latest updates and information, straight from us.
- 💬 Join our [Telegram discussion group](https://t.me/aFreetools) to interact with other users, ask questions, and share tips.
- ✉️ Report issues or share suggestions directly at **contact.freetool@gmail.com**, or through the Feedback option on [freetvgarden.com](https://freetvgarden.com).

We read every message and update this panel whenever there's something worth telling you about — thanks for being here!
